title: Add versioned harness releases and upgrade guidance
acceptance_criteria: A versioned harness release marker has a validated semantic version and matching changelog entry.
Release notes state the adoption actions for the first tagged release.
Maintainer guidance defines how to publish an annotated tag and GitHub release.
Adopter guidance defines how to compare releases, adapt changes, verify the result, and record the new baseline without overwriting project-specific configuration.
Contract tests pass and the full harness verification passes.

title: Hand off harness adoption to product readiness work
acceptance_criteria: Adoption guidance defines the boundary between an adopted harness, an adopted project gate, and product readiness.
An adopting agent is instructed to execute the adoption checklist, record evidence and unresolved decisions, and report the adoption outcome without claiming product readiness.
The guidance tells the agent to identify the first actionable production-readiness work item and offer to continue immediately when authority and acceptance criteria are clear.
Primary entry points and focused contract tests keep the adoption handoff guidance visible and prevent its completion boundary from regressing.
The full harness verification passes.

title: Allow verified dependency maintenance pull requests
acceptance_criteria: Review binding bypasses the latest completed digest only for a deterministic dependency-maintenance change.
The classification permits only pnpm lockfile changes, package dependency or package-manager changes, and the pnpm setup version in the verification workflow.
Source, scripts, arbitrary manifest fields, other workflow changes, queue evidence, and unknown paths remain digest-bound.
The full harness gate remains mandatory and contracts cover accepted and rejected dependency-maintenance changes.
The full harness verification passes.

title: Preserve review binding across merged maintenance
acceptance_criteria: Approved documentation and dependency maintenance remain valid before merge and after the default branch advances.
The maintenance exception uses a stable reviewed implementation baseline and still rejects unrelated implementation changes.
Missing or invalid baseline evidence fails closed without accepting an arbitrary clean tree.
Temporary Git contracts cover maintenance lifecycle and rejected changes, and the review-binding documentation describes the behavior.

title: Discover workspaces without silently truncating YAML
acceptance_criteria: Comments and supported valid pnpm workspace package lists preserve every declared workspace pattern.
Unsupported or malformed workspace syntax produces a stable finding instead of silently omitting targets.
Temporary fixtures cover comments between patterns, supported list syntax, malformed configuration, and the approved inventory audit.
The supported discovery contract is documented without broadening the bootstrap to other package managers.

title: Use the final review as the approval authority
acceptance_criteria: Completed features require approval and required evidence in one designated final report; new features use the canonical final filename.
Numbered review rounds cannot override a rejected or incomplete final report, except for an explicit fixed mapping of existing historical final approvals.
Review binding and completion evaluate the same canonical report without rewriting historical reviews.
Focused contracts cover old approvals, rejected final reviews, and valid canonical approval.

title: Require approval and completion at delivery boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Fast development feedback remains available while a feature is in progress.
The final local gate requires an approved review for active implementation work.
The CI merge boundary requires finalized normal feature state and preserves approved maintenance lanes.
Focused contracts prove unfinished or unreviewed work is rejected at the appropriate boundary and valid workflows pass.
Role and verification documentation describes the development, approval, and merge checks.

title: Use an explicit comparison base for verification
acceptance_criteria: Fallow and change classifiers receive one explicitly resolved comparison base.
A pushed feature branch still analyzes its committed changes against the intended target branch.
CI supplies the correct PR or pre-push baseline and non-main default branches have a documented supported override.
Focused Git and command contracts cover pushed branches, detached checkout inputs, default-branch pushes, and invalid bases.

title: Permit project verification in reusable gate contracts
acceptance_criteria: The documented verify:project extension passes reusable harness command contracts.
Required harness stages and failure propagation remain protected without requiring the exact sample verify command.
Temporary stub-command fixtures cover a successful extension and a failing project check.
Sample-specific expectations and adoption guidance are clearly distinguished.

title: Verify the same implementation snapshot that was approved
acceptance_criteria: Final local verification rejects intended tracked implementation differences between the index and working tree.
Development feedback permits ordinary unstaged work and unrelated user artifacts remain untouched.
Review and completion evidence files retain their documented digest exclusions.
Focused contracts cover staged approval, later unstaged edits, clean snapshots, and evidence-only changes.
